from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    marker_rows = [
        r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
        if Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] != background
    ]
    marker_cols = [
        c for c in range(w)
        if Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0] != background
    ]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(marker_rows) - 1):
        row = []
        r1, r2 = marker_rows[i], marker_rows[i + 1]
        for j in range(len(marker_cols) - 1):
            c1, c2 = marker_cols[j], marker_cols[j + 1]
            corners = (grid[r1][c1], grid[r1][c2],
                       grid[r2][c1], grid[r2][c2])
            row.append(corners[0] if all(x == corners[0] for x in corners) else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    fill = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if sum(x != fill for x in grid[r]) > w / 2]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] != fill for r in range(h)) > h / 2]

    nonfill = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x != fill)
    divider = nonfill.most_common(1)[0][0]

    result = []
    for i in range(len(row_lines) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for j in range(len(col_lines) - 1):
            corners = (
                grid[row_lines[i]][col_lines[j]],
                grid[row_lines[i]][col_lines[j + 1]],
                grid[row_lines[i + 1]][col_lines[j]],
                grid[row_lines[i + 1]][col_lines[j + 1]],
            )
            if corners[0] != divider and all(x == corners[0] for x in corners):
                out_row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                out_row.append(fill)
        result.append(out_row)
    return result

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    fill = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    row_lines = [
        r for r in range(h)
        if sum(v != fill for v in grid[r]) > w / 2
    ]
    col_lines = [
        c for c in range(w)
        if sum(grid[r][c] != fill for r in range(h)) > h / 2
    ]

    # The most common non-fill color on the candidate grid lines is the
    # separator; the other colors at intersections are the markers.
    crossings = [
        grid[r][c]
        for r in row_lines for c in col_lines
        if grid[r][c] != fill
    ]
    separator = Counter(crossings).most_common(1)[0][0]

    def has_marker_on_row(r):
        return any(grid[r][c] not in (fill, separator) for c in col_lines)

    def has_marker_on_col(c):
        return any(grid[r][c] not in (fill, separator) for r in row_lines)

    row_lines = [r for r in row_lines if has_marker_on_row(r)]
    col_lines = [c for c in col_lines if has_marker_on_col(c)]

    result = []
    for i in range(len(row_lines) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for j in range(len(col_lines) - 1):
            corners = (
                grid[row_lines[i]][col_lines[j]],
                grid[row_lines[i]][col_lines[j + 1]],
                grid[row_lines[i + 1]][col_lines[j]],
                grid[row_lines[i + 1]][col_lines[j + 1]],
            )
            color = corners[0]
            if color not in (fill, separator) and all(v == color for v in corners):
                out_row.append(color)
            else:
                out_row.append(fill)
        result.append(out_row)
    return result
